new_candidates.body:
A sleeping rigid body is woken whenever an awake body's padded broadphase AABB overlaps its own, even when they never touch. While awake it drifts slightly, then falls asleep again at a different pose, so adding a body to a scene changes the motion of another body it never contacts.

Repro (pybullet 3.2.7, useMaximalCoordinates=1, sleeping enabled): a 0.5 m cube rests on a plane and falls asleep. A 0.25 m sphere then rolls past one of its edges with a 12 cm gap. getContactPoints reports nothing, yet the cube is woken for 40 steps and ends up 6.5 µm from where it ends up without the sphere. The difference becomes exactly 0 with setCollisionFilterPair(cube, sphere, …, 0) or with sleeping disabled. The reach follows the AABB padding: up to about 16 cm with the default contactBreakingThreshold of 0.02, and 35 cm with 0.1.
new_candidates.title: Sleeping body is woken and moved by a body that never comes within contact range
